narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, energetic, punchy explainer narrator. Brisk delivery with no long pauses.

worker.instruct: Calm, slightly amused water-quality technician, quick and matter-of-fact.

tourist.instruct: Confident, chirpy tourist explaining something she just learned, quick and bright.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You jog past the city reservoir. The water is gone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Millions of black balls, bobbing like a giant ball pit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You figure they're saving water from the sun. Smart.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You explain it to a tourist like an expert.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a lab worker climbs out of a boat, holding a bottle.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Evaporation is the bonus. The sun was making a chemical.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Back in twenty oh seven, tests found bromate above the federal limit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bromate is a suspected carcinogen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The water had bromide, plus chlorine to disinfect it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Add sunlight, and the two make bromate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To prove it, scientists hung bottles at different depths in a reservoir.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bottles near the surface, in more sunlight, made more bromate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cut the light by about eighty percent, and bromate stopped forming.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Floating covers would cost over three hundred million dollars.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Plastic balls cost thirty-six cents each.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They block about ninety-five percent of the sunlight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They're black because carbon black shields the plastic from ultraviolet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In twenty fifteen, the biggest reservoir reached ninety-six million balls.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yes, they cut evaporation too. But sunlight was the real enemy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On your way back, the tourist is explaining it to someone else.

lines.speaker: tourist
lines.text: It's just to stop evaporation!
